'''Falsswon''', or '''False One''', was a [[Color/Legends|blue]]-skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] who lived in the city of [[Tolea Biqua]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. He was once interviewed by [[Melanda Forswoth]] for [[Eye on Cularin]]. He soon became irritated with her questions, pulled a blaster, and shot the camera, after which Melanda disappeared.
